notes: Comprehensive collection of Texas animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Houston SPCA celebrating 100 years of service. Austin Pets Alive helped Austin achieve 90%+ save rate since 2011. Texas Humane Heroes found homes for 1,700+ pets in 2024. Coverage spans Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Fort Worth, El Paso, Corpus Christi, and Amarillo.
